## Platform: LinkedIn

**Caption:**

A car serviced on a consistent schedule holds its value. One detailed reactively — whenever the owner gets around to it — doesn't.

That's the real case for a maintenance membership. Not convenience for its own sake, but a structured protocol that removes human inertia from the equation entirely. Our Signature members ($149/month) receive bi-monthly detailing, ceramic maintenance top-ups, and priority scheduling. The car is always in good condition — not because they remembered to book, but because the calendar handles it.

Across a year, Signature members save up to 35% compared to equivalent one-off bookings. More importantly: they're not managing it at all.

If you run a company vehicle, oversee a small fleet, or own a prestige car you've invested heavily in, the maths on a maintenance membership is straightforward. We operate across Melbourne's Inner East, Bayside, and Mornington Peninsula — mobile to your home, office, or car park. Drop us a message or visit the link to see both membership tiers.
